edges.subject: mutations in NCL genes
edges.quote: The Neuronal Ceroid Lipofuscinoses (NCL), otherwise known as Batten disease, are a group of neurodegenerative diseases caused by mutations in 13 known genes.

edges.subject: neuronal ceroid lipofuscinosis
edges.quote: characterised by the accumulation of autofluorescent storage material in the lysosomes of cells.
